playerFlow.vanillaPlay: REDlauncher Enable mods OFF after launcher-off Biology-inactive behavior is accepted
playerFlow.update: close-game_then_use-version-aware Biology release update path with manifest collision checks
playerFlow.uninstall: run self-contained Uninstall Biology.exe; remove only manifest-proven owned files and report changed/ambiguous files

ownerManifest.rule: Every ordinary runtime/package payload file installed by a Biology release must appear exactly once. No broad shared-root deletion is permitted during uninstall.

stateAndSaves.e3PreferencePersistence: Biology ScriptableSystem persistent field in the Cyberpunk save

notes: runtimeRoots are allowed locations, not a claim that every final release uses every root
the player-facing package contains only roots actually required by that exact build
redscript and standalone cybercmd are the only retained generic runtime dependencies and are tracked per file; cybercmd only executes redscript's scc.toml startup compilation task
the REDmod-owned Biology activation marker remains the sole whole-mod activation authority; redscript/cybercmd plumbing is non-authoritative
the public artifact never includes developer deployment receipts, reports, staging, saves, game executables, stock game archives or local ReferenceMods payload
full Steam reinstall is exceptional clean-room/recovery, not the normal Biology uninstall path
